create_task_config: create a TaskConfig dataclass to define an MLGym task with dataset configs, baseline paths, and evaluation scripts
evaluate_csv_submission: evaluate a CSV submission file by running the evaluation script and parsing JSON metrics output
run_baseline_scores: run baseline scripts to compute baseline scores for a task and update the TaskConfig
setup_lm_task: set up a language model task with GPU detection and distributed training support using torchrun
register_task_class: register a new ML task class in the AbstractMLTaskMeta registry for lookup by name
